name: XXL-JOB
description: XXL-JOB distributed task scheduler console inside DBX: executor groups, job management, manual trigger, start/stop, scheduling logs, GLUE source, and trigger reports.

contributions.label: XXL-JOB admin
contributions.description: Connects to the XXL-JOB admin console (xxl-job-admin) with its own login form and cookie session.

fields.label: Host
fields.placeholder: 127.0.0.1, or paste the full console URL

fields.label: Admin password
fields.description: Stored in the DBX secret store; the workbench never receives it.

fields.label: Access token (SSO / OpenAPI)
fields.description: Only for consoles that replaced the form login with XXL-SSO or guard the OpenAPI. Sent as the XXL-JOB-ACCESS-TOKEN header and exchanged at /api/login. Leave empty for a classic console.

fields.label: Browser session cookie
fields.description: Optional but decisive for consoles with a custom or SSO-only auth flow: paste the Cookie header of a logged-in browser session. The plugin then skips login and reuses it exactly, so it works whenever the browser works.

fields.label: Custom auth header
fields.description: Optional. A full header such as "Authorization: Bearer ey..." or "xxl-sso-token: ...". A bare value is sent as a Bearer token.

fields.label: Console context path
fields.description: Context path the console is deployed under. Use / when it is deployed at the root.

fields.label: Skip TLS verification
fields.description: Accept a self-signed certificate on an https console.

actions.label: Detect console path
actions.description: Probes the usual XXL-JOB context paths on this host and fills in the one that answers.

actions.label: Inspect console API
actions.description: Probes the classic xxl-job-admin endpoints and the REST layouts of restyled consoles, then reports what this server really answers. Useful when login returns 404.

contributions.label: XXL-JOB console
contributions.description: Manage executor groups, jobs, triggers, scheduling logs, and GLUE source of one XXL-JOB instance.

recommendations.label: Review scheduling health
recommendations.prompt: Review the XXL-JOB scheduling health of the open connection: which jobs are stopped, which recent executions failed, and what to fix first.

contributions.description: Read executor groups, job definitions, and scheduling logs, and trigger a job run, through the open XXL-JOB connection.

zh-CN.name: XXL-JOB
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 内管理 XXL-JOB 分布式任务调度：执行器分组、任务管理、手动触发、启停、调度日志、GLUE 源码与运行报表。

alancere.xxljob.connection.label: XXL-JOB 管理端
alancere.xxljob.connection.description: 通过管理端自带的登录表单和 Cookie 会话连接 xxl-job-admin。

host.label: 主机
host.placeholder: 127.0.0.1，也可直接粘贴完整管理端地址

password.label: 管理端密码
password.description: 保存在 DBX 密钥库中，工作台不会拿到密码。

access_token.label: Access Token（SSO / OpenAPI）
access_token.description: 仅当管理端用 XXL-SSO 取代了表单登录、或对 OpenAPI 做了 token 校验时填写。插件会把它作为 XXL-JOB-ACCESS-TOKEN 请求头发送，并用于 /api/login 换取会话；经典管理端留空即可。

session_cookie.label: 浏览器会话 Cookie
session_cookie.description: 可选项，但对自定义/SSO 登录方式最有效：把已登录浏览器里请求头的 Cookie 值粘进来，插件会跳过登录直接复用，浏览器能连上它就能连上。

auth_header.label: 自定义认证请求头
auth_header.description: 可选项。可以是完整的 “Authorization: Bearer xxx” 或 “xxl-sso-token: xxx”；只填值时会按 Bearer token 发送。

context_path.label: 管理端上下文路径
context_path.description: 管理端部署的上下文路径；部署在根路径时填写 /。

skip_tls_verify.label: 跳过 TLS 校验
skip_tls_verify.description: https 管理端使用自签名证书时勾选。

detect-endpoint.label: 自动探测管理端路径
detect-endpoint.description: 依次探测常见的 XXL-JOB 上下文路径，并把有响应的那个回填到表单。

inspect-endpoint.label: 检查管理端接口
inspect-endpoint.description: 探测经典 xxl-job-admin 接口与新版前端的 REST 布局，并报告该服务端实际应答，便于定位登录 404。

alancere.xxljob.workbench.label: XXL-JOB 控制台
alancere.xxljob.workbench.description: 管理一个 XXL-JOB 实例的执行器分组、任务、触发、调度日志与 GLUE 源码。
